case: A guard gains a SECOND edge that calls it, which is an attachment the table does not name and must not refuse.
why: The attachment table states where a guard MUST be called, not where it may be. A check that also refused an extra call site would refuse the ordinary way a boundary is widened -- and three rows of the table already name two edges and one names three, so the table would be contradicting itself. Here `guard.derivation.writer_is_release_path` is additionally demanded on `recomputed_at_release -> matched`, which is a strengthening: the release path is the only writer on that edge too.
